{{Quote|I'm doing my best, but the Republic's stretched thin. Command tells me two weeks&mdash;|Liagri informs Brant Organa of the situation with the sensor arrays|<ref name="TORCS" />}}
'''Liagri''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war, they were stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where the Twi'lek aided the Great [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] in the [[Alderaan Civil War]], fought between the various [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great Houses]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Brant Organa]] contacted Liagri about a failed attempt to repair a set of [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]] that had been damaged by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the rival [[House of Thul]]. Liagri, however, informed Organa that no [[Republic soldier|Republic troops]] were available to help immediately. A Republic-aligned individual then approached Liagri and offered to repair the [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], which the individual successfully did.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Say again, Duke Brant&ndash; the sensor repairs failed? This is our fourth attempt. You say it was House Thul forces again?|Liagri receives a report from Brant Organa|<ref name="TORCS" />}}
[[File:Coastal_Sensor_Array.png|thumb|left|170px|Liagri discussed repairing coastal sensor arrays with Brant Organa.]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]<ref name="TORCS" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> Liagri served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of the [[Republic Army]], fighting against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TORCS" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the Twi'lek held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] and was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] aiding the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]], in the [[Alderaan Civil War]], a power struggle between all of the Great Houses.<ref name="TORCS" />

During that year, while Liagri was in the area known as [[Foothill Paths]], they were contacted via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] by [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Brant Organa]] of House Organa, who informed the sergeant that the fourth attempt to repair a number of coastal [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]] in areas nearby, including the [[Apalis Coast]] and [[Alsakan Lowlands]], had failed. The [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] of the arrays had been carried out by forces of the [[House of Thul]], an Imperial-backed rival to House Organa, which had also prevented further repair attempts. Organa's men needed the arrays to track the Thul [[Trooper/Legends|troops]]' advance, but Liagri told the duke that Republic forces were spread too thin to help and that the next attempt at repairs would only be completed in two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]' [[Time/Legends|time]], which the duke concluded would not be quick enough to save himself or his troops.<ref name="TORCS" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
As Liagri gave Organa the bad news, a Republic-aligned individual approached the sergeant and offered to help repair the arrays. Liagri and Organa gave the individual coordinates for the [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and told the individual to fire a [[flare gun]] from a broken bridge on the [[Frostflower Path]] in the Alsakan Lowlands once the task was complete. The individual went on to successfully repair each of the arrays.<ref name="TORCS" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Liagri had [[Color/Legends|light brown]] skin and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. When informing the duke that the next set of repairs could not take place immediately, the Twi'lek was apologetic.<ref name="TORCS" />

==Equipment==
While in the Foothill Paths, Liagri wore blue [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and made use of a large table capable of displaying holograms of both individuals and the surrounding area.<ref name="TORCS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Duke Brant Organa? Come in, Duke Brant? Blast this comm signal!|Liagri's dialogue if players refuse to accept the request|<ref name="TORCS" />}}
Liagri first appeared in [[2011]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG video game]] released by [[BioWare]]. Liagri serves as the starting point for the Republic quest "Coastal Safeguards." This quest is optional, and players may refuse to take it; however, this article assumes they finish it as part of one hundred percent game completion.<ref name="TORCS" />
